text:
nina: uploaded a compact mock for the 'first run' experience focusing on mobile and narrow widths. link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/onboard-compact. Wants feedback on prioritization + copy. :iphone: carl: skimmed. Like the idea of detecting project type and auto-checking relevant steps (e.g., node sample => show 'Install SDK' first). Could we surface a tiny badge on each sample: 'auto-detected' when it matches user's repo? jamie: accessibility quick notes: 1) the progress meter is visual-only right now, needs aria-valuenow & label. 2) the dismiss 'x' on the banner is too small for touch targets on mobile. 3) color of success check circles at 18px fails contrast with background at 3:1. nina: good catches. For the meter, wanted an animated pill with percentage. Happy to add aria attributes if we get suggested markup. Also thinking about adaptive copy: 'You're all set' vs 'Complete setup' depending on stage. Thoughts? carl: adaptive copy is great. prefer 'You're all set' on final screen. For intermediate steps use action verbs: 'Connect repo', 'Run sample'. Keeps scannable. jamie: markup suggestion for the progress bar (screen-reader friendly): ```html
45%
``` jamie: also keyboard: when checklist expands it should not steal focus from main content. Use focus management: focus moves to panel heading, not first interactive element, and Esc closes the panel. nina: noted. on small screens the sample carousel collapses to a vertical list. worried about long copy trimming important runtime/cost info. propose adding an inline tooltip: '≈ 0.8¢ / run' under each sample card and a chevron to expand details. carl: cost microcopy should be consistent: use cent symbol and one decimal place (e.g., '≈ 0.8¢ / run'). Add a hover/click for 'how this is estimated' linking to docs. jamie: mobile tap target rule: 44x44px minimum. will mark in the spec. Also recommend changing yellow labels to an accessible variant: try #E4A200 with a 1px #9A6A00 outline to hit 4.5:1. nina: can you paste that hex in the figma component? also can we show a subtle skeleton state for sample cards when runtimes are being fetched? keeps layout stable. ux-bot: design note: remember to include privacy copy for first-run telemetry opt-in. Use concise sentence: 'Help us improve onboarding (optional)'. Link to privacy. carl: one product trade: if we auto-mark items completed based on telemetry (repo linked, sample run) we need an undo button and a clear tooltip: 'marked complete automatically'. ops wants explicit event names to record: onboard.checklist.auto_complete, onboard.sample.run. jamie: also ensure announcements are reachable by screen readers when auto-complete happens: add aria-live="polite" region text 'Checklist item X completed'. nina: love it. timeline: I'll update Figma with the progress bar aria markup, mobile tap sizes, tooltip placement, and alternate yellow. Update by tomorrow morning. Can people review quickly after? deploy-bot: CI: quickstart-compact branch has no conflicts 7a1 tests passing. carl: will look after standup. If we agree on auto-detect badge, engineering needs a small endpoint to return repo-language hint. Can we scope that as optional? nina: yes optional. we'll default to showing the badge only when confidence > 0.7. Add copy: 'Detected: Node.js (likely)'. jamie: final note: ensure any link in the banner uses descriptive text, not 'click here'. e.g., 'Learn how we estimate costs'. nina: perfect. thanks all. I'll post updated frames and a short spec doc with the ARIA snippets and touch guidelines. ping me if you want to pair on the microcopy. :sparkles:
